tagline: The floor · The fit · The afters

stars.text: Wear the boots you can dance in and still walk home in. Mars is hot, so take the first yes and leave before the third drink turns it into a fight.
Pay cash for one thing and stop: the record, the meal, or the ring. Venus stays in what you keep, and a second purchase spends the luck.
Send the text or delete the draft before you leave the house. Mercury is splitting every message in two, and the unsent one is what keeps you up.
Put the kettle on before you go, and leave the chipped mug on the counter. The Moon is holding a seat, so if someone comes home with you the water is already waiting.
Write your name on the list yourself, then wear the thing you have been saving. The Sun wants one person to see you, and the back of the room is where they walk past.
Fix one line on the list and leave the crossed-out lines where they are. Mercury pays for a single correction, and redoing your face in the back seat only makes you late.
Hand over the aux and let their song play all the way through. Venus is finished with the vote, and you already made your case on the drive over.
If they ask who played, describe the hands and the smoke, and keep the name to yourself. Pluto keeps what you do not post, so the night stays yours when the chat never learns it.
Walk the long way home and say the true thing in one sentence. Jupiter opens that road when you stop explaining it. Don’t wait on the last ferry.
Write down what you spent and the text you still owe, then pick a time to go home. Saturn is keeping the ledger either way. A wristband in a drawer will not remember the night for you.
Send the pin and leave. Let the group chat finish without you. Uranus is with the person who already moved, and another poll leaves you standing on the curb.
One drop of cedar oil behind the ear, then one drink and one person. Neptune blurs the door after midnight, and a third room is how you lose the way home.
